scope: Transfer two identified managed implementation choices to native C++, followed by one assembly-supported layout refinement. No general OpenVDB optimization search.

epochs.E3: Accepted protocol after correcting native direct-mutation invalidation. Stock, mask-only, separate miss helper, and combined variants; coherent64 and six guardrail workloads.
epochs.E4: Isolate layout alone versus cache plus layout; no mask guard. Accepted follow-up with the same corrected native invalidation preflight.

catalogue.M1: Inline 64-pointer cache adds 512 bytes per accessor. No timed allocations except the explicitly separate churn workload.
catalogue.M2: No temporary scalar-access buffers; cache is persistent accessor storage.
catalogue.M3: Native indexed value storage already lacks managed range checks; no range-check-removal experiment applies.
catalogue.M4: Existing native pointers retained under existing safe-accessor invalidation callbacks. No managed pinning or byref transformation.
catalogue.M5: H-001/H-004: additional inline leaf-pointer storage changes accessor size/layout; report its cost and collision controls.
catalogue.M6: H-001/H-004: direct-mapped leaf-location cache avoids parent traversal. Prefetch and alignment tuning are outside the requested transfer.
catalogue.M7: No bulk copies or serialization in these scalar calls.
catalogue.C1: Keep checksum reduction and scalar caller work identical across native arms; accumulator/unrolling changes are outside scope.
catalogue.C2: H-002/H-003/H-005: saturated mask-word guard; mixed activity tests cover its opposite branch. No unsupported branch-miss claim.
catalogue.C3: SIMD/bulk APIs would change the scalar accessor workload and are outside scope.
catalogue.C4: Coordinate/slot arithmetic uses shifts and masks; no ISA-specific changes requested.
catalogue.S1: H-002: avoid idempotent writes to fully active activity words; partial64 and reactivation tests preserve semantics.
catalogue.S2: H-001: secondary leaf lookup, signed full-origin equality on collisions, original tree fallback on misses.
catalogue.S3: Mutable tree topology precludes frozen mappings as an equivalent transfer.
catalogue.S4: Existing clear/release/stealNode callbacks invalidate secondary leaves. Direct Tree.addTile requires explicit clearAllAccessors before replacing nodes; E1/E2 preflight invalidation defect was corrected and measurements rerun.
catalogue.S5: No value compression or changed representation.
catalogue.R1: No reflection, runtime feature flags or delegate dispatch. Template code is inspected at the generated native caller.
catalogue.R2: H-004/H-005 arise from an observed leaf-index lambda call in E1; test a small inline hit path and explicit non-inlined miss helper. H-006/H-007 isolate layout alone; no consistent coherent read or write benefit.
catalogue.R3: Compile-time experiment switches; no per-access environment reads.
catalogue.T1: Single-thread timed scalar kernels; no false-sharing hypothesis.
catalogue.T2: Original one-accessor-per-thread and exclusive mutation contract retained; no synchronization removed.
catalogue.T3: Default native MutexT=void already performs no per-access locking. No lock-removal explanation is valid here.
catalogue.T4: No threading or scheduling changes; all build and timing phases serialized under the shared host lock.

limitations: One processor and native compiler; no cross-machine conclusion.
Focused native correctness tests are not the upstream test suite.
Accessor layout and public helper additions are experimental, not an ABI-stable upstream patch.
stoppingCondition: Both requested implementation choices, their combination, and the source-supported call-layout counterfactual have been measured with correctness and losing-distribution controls. Further capacity tuning, new hardware/compiler ports and full upstream integration are separate work.
